task.description: Implement IDN-02 (Group management) in the backend per src/design/idn-02-group-management.md. Add the group registry and membership join model, implement the group create/add-member/list-members/remove-member API flow, preserve idempotent add-member semantics, enforce the non-existent user and missing group error mappings, and wire group-aware task claim authorization so any ACTIVE member may claim a GROUP-assigned task without mutating the assignment. Write the additive SQL migration(s) required by the design, keep all SQL parameterised, and update any affected Zig modules so zig build and database migration application both pass.
acceptance_criteria: All code paths from src/design/idn-02-group-management.md are implemented
Database migrations apply cleanly to a fresh test database
Group CRUD and membership semantics match the design, including idempotent duplicate adds
Task claim authorization honors ACTIVE membership for GROUP assignees
No SQL string interpolation of user data is introduced

result.summary: Implemented IDN-02 group management in the backend, including group and membership persistence, additive migration 018_identity_group_members.sql, group CRUD and membership HTTP handlers, paginated member listing, and GROUP-assignee task claim authorization for active members.
